issue.title: clamp() for mathlib, so discount percentages stop going negative
issue.body:
The invoice service applies discount percentages from a form, and people sometimes type -5 or 140. We'd like a clamp(x, lo, hi) in mathlib that keeps a value inside a range, and it should refuse a range that makes no sense (lo above hi) with a RangeError rather than guessing.

Please add clamp to the README's API section too, so the invoice team can find it.

Expect:
- math.js exports clamp(x, lo, hi), which returns x limited to the range lo to hi
- clamp(x, lo, hi) throws a RangeError when lo is greater than hi
- README.md documents every function math.js exports
- npm test passes
expect: math.js exports clamp(x, lo, hi), which returns x limited to the range lo to hi
clamp(x, lo, hi) throws a RangeError when lo is greater than hi
README.md documents every function math.js exports

lines.line: math.js exports clamp(x, lo, hi), which returns x limited to the range lo to hi
lines.evidence: Ran the checkout (the fetch worked; HEAD is 763afc8485f96b09542e34b362ab039b168e6971). Then ran the Check 1 node -e command from the repo root and it exited 0. All 9 cases matched: -5 0 100 -> 0, 140 0 100 -> 100, 42 0 100 -> 42, 0 0 100 -> 0, 100 0 100 -> 100, 7 3 3 -> 3, -1 -10 -2 -> -2, -20 -10 -2 -> -10, 2.5 1 3 -> 2.5. clamp is in module.exports = { add, subtract, multiply, clamp }.

lines.line: clamp(x, lo, hi) throws a RangeError when lo is greater than hi
lines.evidence: Ran the Check 2 node -e command and it exited 0. It printed: 5 10 0 threw RangeError; 0 1 0 threw RangeError; 50 100 0 threw RangeError; -3 -1 -2 threw RangeError. In math.js, clamp throws new RangeError when lo > hi.

lines.line: README.md documents every function math.js exports
lines.evidence: The Check 3 command exactly as written crashed with 'SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression: /^#+s*adds*(/m: Unterminated group' and exited 1. This comes from the brief's own shell quoting, not from the PR: inside bash double quotes the backslashes in the regex string are lost before node sees them. I reran the same script inside single quotes so the intended regex (a heading, then the name, then an open paren) reaches node intact. Output: 'exports: add, subtract, multiply, clamp' and 'missing: none', exit 0. I read README.md: each function has its own heading, ### add(a, b), ### subtract(a, b), ### multiply(a, b) and ### clamp(x, lo, hi). Each heading has a description: add returns the sum; subtract returns a minus b; multiply returns the product; clamp returns x limited to lo..hi inclusive and throws RangeError when lo > hi. Each also has an example.

Ran npm test: exit status 0. Summary: tests 5, pass 5, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0. Advisory: test/math.test.js gained clamp tests, including the RangeError case. The PR changes only README.md, math.js and test/math.test.js; add, subtract and multiply are unchanged. Observations: clamp(NaN,0,1) returns NaN, clamp('5',0,10) returns the string '5', and clamp(1,NaN,0) returns 0 without throwing. My worktree is clean, with no local changes.
